name: What is the difference between latex and oil-based exterior paints?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between latex and oil-based exterior paints?

acceptedAnswer.text: Latex (water-based) paints are commonly used for exteriors due to their flexibility, breathability, and easier cleanup. They tend to resist cracking and fading well. Oil-based paints are known for their durability and smooth finish, often preferred for trim or high-traffic areas, but they take longer to dry, can become brittle, and require mineral spirits for cleanup. Your project's specific needs will determine the best choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Latex paints are flexible, breathable, and easy to clean. Oil-based paints offer durability for trim but dry slower.
